title: Pain in the Gluteus Maximus!
text:
Pain in the Gluteus Maximus!. I bought this vacuum to replace an older one. The suction is great. It maneuvers easily. The belt broke after a few uses. I checked several big box stores with no luck. I went on Amazon and purchased the recommended belt. It did not fit. Talked to an Amazon rep. After 15 minutes, the rep said they don't carry a belt for my machine. I had to go to Bissel! and order the belt. So now I'm using the old machine and wondering why I bought a new one!.

Update: The belt broke AGAIN. I hate this machine.
